== Notes ==
* You can use this skill as an [[interrupt]], since any skill being activated by the target when he is blacked out will [[fail]] at the end of the skill's [[activation time]].  This has the advantage that the skill will be interrupted even when the target is using anti-interruption skills, such as [[Glyph of Concentration]] or [[Mantra of Concentration]].
* At rank 12 Domination Magic, Blackout can be maintained on a target by copying it with [[Echo]].

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] appears to be a solar eclipse.
